sections.title: How long does it take? How long does it take to implement a supplier on JAGGAER?
paragraphs: How long does it take? How long does it take to implement a supplier on JAGGAER?
My answer is…It depends • In Network (they have an existing integration with us)
• Hosted = 2-4 weeks • Punch-out = 4-6 weeks • Multiple Integrations = add additional 2-6 weeks
• Caveat: If supplier and customer are both engaged and have a
completed contract, these times can be
• Hosted = 4-8 weeks • Punch-out = 12-16 weeks • Multiple Integrations = add additional 4-6 weeks
• Caveat: If suppliers have worked with other eProcument vendors,
then these times apply. If the
supplier is net new to eProcument and they require development,
then there is no timeframe. Below estimates are based off average duration, not work effort
